snippet.title: StarVaders - Official Accolades Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Take a look at the Accolades Trailer for StarVaders, a roguelike strategy deckbuilder developed by Pengonauts. Players will command unique mech-pilot duos, each with distinct abilities and playstyles, to repel an unrelenting alien invasion across three-act campaigns. Catch the latest trailer to garner the critical reception behind StarVaders, available now for PC.
